speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Harvey writes like a man walking on his own beard. I have said it in the street, and I will say it over a chine. The chine is the better audience. It does not answer, and it does not keep a Cambridge.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let it not answer. I am in the middle of a bite, and a man in the middle of a bite is not a congregation. You may have the mustard when I have had the shine off it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: May a man fast from another man's explanations? I ask it over the marrow, which is the honest part of the meal. The beef I understand. The doctor I have not been introduced to, and I decline the introduction.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Thou wilt not fast from me. Pope may do as he pleases. I came unasked, and I am staying. I have no tenpence, and I have a great deal to say, and the one has never stopped the other.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tenpence a head. I will say it once, while the board can still hear a number. Double ale, the chine, the mustard, the bones. Tenpence, and the house will have it of us without a speech, if the room will allow the miracle.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: A speech is how a broke man pays. John, you keep the purse as if it might bruise. I am not in it. That is my contribution, and it is handsomer than Harvey's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are in the room, which is a contribution of a kind. Eat. The mustard is on your side. If you are going to war, war with the man who is not here, and leave John's book alone.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Gladly. Harvey is in Cambridge, or in his own opinion, which is the larger parish. He will have heard that thy comedy keeps a pedant and a braggart, and he will be insufferable if either of them is him. Tell me which. I did not cross the town for the beef, though I am eating the beef.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The page.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: The page. A boy with a clean shirt and a dirty observation. Thou art either kind or careful, and I forgive thee, which is more than Harvey would, and less than thou deservest.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sing, if thou wilt be forgiven at this table. Augustine has been waiting to make thee useful. I have been waiting to make thee pay. Thou canst do them in either order, Tom, so long as both happen before Will escapes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: One verse, Tom. Not the doctor. A tune. The parlour has had enough prose to salt a week, and the salt is not till Wednesday.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: For you, Augustine, and for no critic alive.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Put up thy pen, put up thy gown. The town is full, and thou art down.

speaker: will_kemp
text: He sings with mustard on the note. I respect a craft I can see. You may keep the verse, Tom. I am keeping the chine.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Now the cup. One cup, Tom. A penny. Thou hast had the rest of the ale on other men's reckoning, and a penny is small enough to be pride instead of payment. Pay it, and look as if it hurt.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: A penny. I have a penny. I have not the tenpence, and I will not dress the difference as a principle. There. The cup is mine. The opinion remains mine. Harvey remains a beard with feet.

speaker: john_heminges
text: We have come through our first winter as a company without one quarrel over the purse.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will touch the beef, which has quarrelled with nobody. Kemp, you have mustard on the chin, and it is the only shine I mean to discuss.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Leave the chin. The fast and I are in negotiation, and I am winning, because the fast is not in the parlour. On Wednesday it may sit down. Tonight it can wait in the yard.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The verse will do. I am not asking for a second. A second becomes a catch, and a catch becomes a noise the host charges for. One verse is a gift. Two is a bill.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Charge the doctor. He has the beard and the leisure, and between them a man might endow a college. Thy page is a coward's answer, Will, and I like it, and I am not done with Cambridge.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are done enough. It is close on nine. I am in pain.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Where?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the purse. It's catching.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then go, before thou lendest him anything out of manners. Thou wilt not get it back, and John will be asked to write the loss as fellowship, and John will refuse, and the refusal will take until midnight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will not write fellowship as a loss. I will write tenpence a head, and a penny received of Master Nashe, and nothing else. The winter stands as I said it. I have touched the table. I am not touching it again for luck.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Go home, William. A man may leave a supper before the explanations are finished. I mean to try it myself when the bones are honestly done, and not before. The marrow still has a duty.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Take the pain with you. It is the only thing at this table not sold at tenpence. You gave him the page, Will, and he paid a penny for the privilege. I am not asking anyone to enter that in a book.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Go, then. Catch thy pain at home, where it can be private and useless. I shall stay and finish Harvey, and the chine, and anyone still fool enough to listen. Augustine, your tune was short. I forgive it. John, your tenpence is a very small gate to so much beef.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast the right of the leaving, Dick. He has the penny and the page. I am going. Do not any of you follow the purse. It is not receiving tonight.
